text: pack-agent 是面向 DSH Web 的 modpack 管理插件，可把 pack 投影到当前工作区并维护 SQLite catalog。它向 DSH 注册工具、命令和 skill provider，支持检测 agent harness、编译或映射 pack、搜索和列出已投影 pack，以及启用或停用 pack、保存和加载白名单预设。它还可从允许集提供 skills，适合在 DSH 工作区组织和检索 agent 技能、规则及 MCP 配置。核心管理功能按当前项目目录操作，不要求额外 API key。

pack-agent manages DSH modpacks in a workspace and indexes them in SQLite. Its DSH tools compile or map packs, search the catalog, control allow lists, and save or load presets. A skill provider exposes skills from allowed packs. It helps organize agent skills, rules, and MCP configuration locally.
想在 DSH 工作区整理 agent 的技能、规则和 MCP 配置包。
怎样把已有的 agent pack 投影进当前 DSH 项目？
我想搜索已经导入的 pack，并查看哪些当前启用。
让 DSH 可以按项目白名单启用或停用技能包。
能不能给 DSH 的 modpack 做本地全文搜索和启停管理？
How can I manage reusable agent skills and rules as packs in my DSH workspace?
I need to search installed packs and save a workspace allow-list preset.
Can I turn a pack into a DSH bundle and manage which projected packs are enabled?
功能「编译 pack」：把 pack 文档编译为 DSH bundle 目录，并返回编译结果。可调用 packagent_compile 工具或 /packagent-compile 命令，输入 pack JSON 或 ZIP 路径。
功能「投影与映射」：把 pack 投影到工作区并加入 catalog，也可映射 Cursor 或 ccui-pack 导出。调用对应工具并提供 pack 路径。
功能「检索与白名单」：在 SQLite catalog 中搜索、列出已投影 pack，并按 id 启用或停用；可保存、加载和列出命名白名单预设。由对应 DSH 工具和 slash command 触发。

@sakikotgw/pack-agent README · Agent Modpack：[](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

English | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Manage DeepSeek Harness config like a Minecraft modpack. Agent Modpack (`packagent`) packs skills, rules, and MCP into a `.pack.zip` and installs them into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other harnesses. Uninstall uses the install ledger.

Requires [Bun](https://bun.sh) ≥ 1.1. npm: [`@sakikotgw/pack-agent`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sakikotgw/pack-agent).

@sakikotgw/pack-agent README · Agent Modpack：agent-pack for DSH lives in [`agent-pack-dsh/`](agent-pack-dsh/README.md). Product design: [`agent-pack-dsh/docs/PRODUCT.md`](agent-pack-dsh/docs/PRODUCT.md). Plugin package: [`@sakikotgw/pack-agent-dsh`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sakikotgw/pack-agent-dsh). See [agent-pack-dsh/plugin/README.md](agent-pack-dsh/plugin/README.md).

@sakikotgw/pack-agent README · From npm：```sh
npm install @sakikotgw/pack-agent
packagent detect
```

One-off:

```sh
npx --yes -p @sakikotgw/pack-agent packagent install foo.pack.json
```

On Windows, `npx --package @sakikotgw/pack-agent -- pack-agent` fails. The bin name is `packagent`.

@sakikotgw/pack-agent README · Use：```sh
packagent agents init
packagent export --agent <id>
packagent install .agent-pack/exports/<id>.pack.json --runtime claude-code
packagent eject --name <id>

`--runtime` installs to one harness. Without it, install targets every harness listed under `Will install to` in `packagent detect`. Install writes the current project only. Pass `--global-config` to write user-global harness config.

@sakikotgw/pack-agent README · Supported harnesses：| id | skills | rules | MCP |
|----|--------|-------|-----|
| `claude-code` | `.claude/skills` | `CLAUDE.md` | `.mcp.json` |
| `codex` | `.agents/skills` | `AGENTS.md` | `.codex/config.toml` |
| `opencode` | `.opencode/skills` | `AGENTS.md` | `opencode.json` |
| `openclaw` | `skills.load.extraDirs` | `AGENTS.md` | `config/mcporter.json` |
| `hermes` | external_dirs | `AGENTS.md` | `~/.hermes/config.yaml` |
| `gemini-cli` | `.gemini/skills` | `GEMINI.md` | `.gemini/settings.json` |
| `windsurf` | `.windsurf/skills` | — | `.windsurf/mcp_config.json` |
| `github-copilot` | — | `.github/copilot-instructions.md` | `.vscode/mcp.json` |

@sakikotgw/pack-agent README · Run from source：```sh
git clone https://github.com/sakikoTGW/pack-agent.git
cd pack-agent
bun install
```
